name: Lucifer's Trials
author: sasjoberg
description: As a melee Knight or a ranged Sorceress, battle your way through a procedurally generated dungeon, fighting hoards of Goblins to achieve Victory. If you can make it to the treasure room, grab your spoils and enter again and again to become a god and continue your never-ending rampage! For all documentation, the team, and all assets used, visit https://github.com/ConanoftheUnreal/ECS189L-Final-Project
